# generating persistence score to label umap by and use for fate prediction

```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
import harmonypy as hm
from pyclustree import clustree
```


# first just on carpall cohort 1
```{python}
cars = sc.read_h5ad("2_car_only_annotated_v3.h5ad")
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color = "labels")
```

```{python}
sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(
    cars, groupby="Timepoint_bin", method="wilcoxon", key_added="dea_timepoint"
)

sc.tl.filter_rank_genes_groups(
    cars,
    min_in_group_fraction=0.25,
    max_out_group_fraction=0.5,
    key="dea_timepoint",
    key_added="dea_timepoint_filtered",
)

degs = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(
    cars,
    group=None,
    key="dea_timepoint_filtered"
)
degs = degs.dropna(subset=["names"])
degs.to_csv("cohort1_timepoint_degs.csv", index=False)
```

```{python}
late_degs = degs[degs["group"] == "Late"]
late_degs = late_degs[late_degs["logfoldchanges"] >1.49]
```

```{python}
persistence_score = list(late_degs.names)
```

```{python}
sc.tl.score_genes(cars, gene_list = persistence_score, score_name="persistence_score")
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color = "persistence_score", cmap = "YlGnBu")
```

```{python}
sc.pl.violin(cars, keys = "persistence_score", groupby = "Timepoint_bin", rotation = 90, size=0)
```

```{python}
scores = cars.obs["persistence_score"]
cuts = scores.quantile([0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8]).values
cars.obs["persistence_quintile"] = pd.cut(
    scores,
    bins=[-np.inf, *cuts, np.inf],
    labels=["Q1_bottom", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5_top"],
)

print(cars.obs["persistence_quintile"].value_counts())
```

```{python}
scores = cars.obs["persistence_score"]

# fixed score cutoffs, so group sizes depend on the data
bins = [-np.inf, 0.05, 0.35, 0.7, np.inf]
labels = ["Negative", "Low", "Medium", "High"]

cars.obs["persistence_group"] = pd.cut(scores, bins=bins, labels=labels)
print(cars.obs["persistence_group"].value_counts())
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
sc.pl.umap(cars, color="persistence_group", palette = "RdBu")
```

```{python}
scores = cars.obs["persistence_score"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.hist(scores, bins=100, color="grey", edgecolor="none")

for cutoff in [0.05, 0.35, 0.7]:
    ax.axvline(cutoff, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=1)

ax.set_xlabel("Persistence score")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of cells")
ax.set_title("Persistence score distribution")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
counts = pd.crosstab(
    cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"],
    cars.obs["persistence_group"],
)
print(counts)

ax = counts.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(8, 5), edgecolor="none", colormap = "RdBu")
ax.set_xlabel("Timepoint")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of cells")
ax.set_title("Cells per persistence group at each timepoint")
ax.legend(title="Persistence group")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
props = pd.crosstab(
    cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"],
    cars.obs["persistence_group"],
    normalize="index",
)
ax = props.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, figsize=(8, 5), edgecolor="none", colormap = "RdBu")
ax.set_ylabel("Proportion of cells")
ax.set_xlabel("Timepoint")
ax.legend(title="Persistence group", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc="upper left")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
cohort1_persistence_signature = late_degs
```

```{python}
cars = cars[cars.obs["labels"] != "GD/CD8+ T"].copy()
```

# then look on integrated dataset of both cohorts
```{python}

)
```

